title: Fixed Rooted Three Claw Crystal Totem
description: One original complete static fantasy crystal totem: an asymmetrically winding wood-like central stem joins three sweeping rooted feet with finite ground soles and three independently editable inward-curving tapered crown claws around one complete double-ended octagonal opaque crystal. The claw routes spread out from the stem, curve around the crystal body and turn back toward its upper point; restrained whole stem bindings finish the object. No museum crystal-cluster mesh or carved rune slab imported, no new object made by changing glyphs, prism counts or pedestal height. One newly drawn whole rooted support-and-held-core silhouette, three opaque untextured PBR materials, metre units and horizontally centred ground origin. One model and zero scenes. Invented decorative fantasy art, not a real plant or religious object; no light emission, transparency, magic effect, motion, load, stability or safety performance claimed.
